|   |   |   |-- One atomic apply/undo checkpoint per flush
|   |   |   `-- Failure leaves prior flushes committed; pending tail is unapplied
|   |   |-- applyBatch(): final-state receipts and resulting version
|   |   |   `-- Queued handles enable dependent writes; they are not receipts
|   |   |-- Immediate mode: apply each edit; return projected node results
|   |   `-- expectedVersion matches initial version; each apply guards next version
|   |       `-- Timeout retry replays results; resends unacknowledged IDs/versions
|   |-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService.apply()/applyBatch(): select target
|   |   |-- Isolated proposal -> ChangeSessionService.apply()

|   |           |-- Persist exported history through AgentChat's callback

|   |-- DiagramEditService: prompt generation or supplied candidate

|   |   |-- Track progress/cancel before application; retain result for retry

|   |   |-- Prepare all supplied/generated results before one atomic application

|   `-- Revision and publication boundaries
|       |-- Pure revision operations return immutable values

|       `-- Controller installs revisions and records history; catalog save is separate
